newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas says to make car engines with Sauber.
newsitem.headline: Petronas says to make car engines with Sauber.

text.p: Malaysia's state oil company Petronas said on Wednesday it plans to go into commercial production of car engines with Swiss racing engine maker Sauber.
"We'll have the prototype ready by June 1998," Petronas chairman Azizan Zainul Abidin told reporters after unveiling a new Formula One racing engine developed by Sauber for Petronas.
Azizan said a detailed marketing study will be undertaken by the joint-venture company, Sauber Petronas Engineering A.G., before the launch of the prototype.
He said Petronas holds a 40 percent stake in the joint-venture company while Sauber holds 60 percent.
